subtasks: Pick up the broom, hand it over to the right hand, then use the dustpan to sweep the objects.
Sweep the blue block from its right side into the dustpan with the broom. Hold the dustpan with the left hand.
Sweep the yellow block into the dustpan with the broom in the right hand. Keep the collected objects in the pan.
Sweep the remaining white piece into the dustpan with the broom. Keep the black piece and both colored blocks inside.
Set the loaded dustpan down gently and release it. Set the broom on the table to the right, then return both empty hands to their starting poses.
